services.name: School Programs
services.desc: Our school programs are designed to encourage exploration in learning. Taught by environmental educators, our programs meet aspects of Ohio proficiency standards. The Nature Center's school programs are designed to encourage exploration and fun in learning. Each program is modeled after specific aspects of Ohio proficiency testing and correlates with Ohio's core standards. The Nature Center's environmental educators are trained and dedicated professionals with long term commitment to place based environmental education.
